meta.title: Extend a live RFQ by 2 Hours
gaps: The requested live RFQ with no bids cannot be prepared because the fixed live prepared state contains one bid.
The updated end time cannot be independently compared across the event list and vendor portal; extend_time only verifies the saved end-time calculation on the event page.

steps.note: Open the API-prepared live RFQ without creating or searching for another event.
